>
[Zealous Rush](/Feats.aspx?ID=4674) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 118

**Trigger**
You cast a divine spell that takes 1 action or more to cast and that affects only you or your equipment

</column>

---

You bless yourself on the move. Stride up to 10 feet. If the spell took 2 or more actions, you can Stride up to your full Speed instead.
name: Zealous Rush
